title: bupleurum aureum var. breviinvolucratum
intro: Bupleurum aureum var. breviinvolucratum, commonly known as Japanese hedge parsley or dwarf borne of gold, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and acting as an anti-oxidant. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum aureum var. breviinvolucratum include hepatoprotective, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
